raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The H3 video VAE splits frames into tiles of `vae_tile_size` with at least `vae_tile_overlap_min` overlap and stitches them back in pixel and latent coordinates. Nothing validated the two values, so on the real checkpoint:

- `vae_tile_overlap_min >= vae_tile_size` made `split_tiles` loop forever, and the request hung in the decoding stage after denoising had finished;
- a tile size that is not a multiple of the spatial compression ratio (16) failed only at the end of decoding with `decoded frames 736x1280 smaller than target canvas 768x1344`.

## Modifications

- `configs/models/vaes/minimax_h3_contract.py`, `minimax_h3_video.py` and `runtime/models/vaes/minimax_h3_video_vae/klvae.py`: reject non-positive or non-integer values, an overlap that is not smaller than the tile, and values that are not multiples of the compression ratio. The check runs both when the VAE config is post-processed and when the tiled-decoding settings are applied, so a bad config fails when the VAE loads.
- `test/unit/test_minimax_h3_vae_tiling.py`: invalid values at both entry points, and valid settings that reconstruct the pixel and latent canvases exactly.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit: `test_minimax_h3_vae_tiling.py` 2 passed, 60 subtests passed. Without the fix the new tests fail.

Real MiniMax-H3 FL2VA checkpoint, TP2 on 2 x B200, t2va, 4 s, 50 steps, seed 42. Server runs on this branch head, on a merge of the three H3 fixes (this PR, the VAE tile validation and the sigma preflight), and on unpatched `main` (`2948662026`).

**Regression** (bit-identical, so no frame comparison is shown; unpatched `main` vs this branch merged with the other two H3 fixes). Frame difference is 0 at every sampled pixel, and the video/audio latents and mp4 match bit for bit:

| | unpatched `main` | merged fixes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| video latent `[1,24,32,48,84]` + audio latent `[2,32,178]`, sha256 prefix | `e3f82e7f2006` | `e3f82e7f2006` |
| decoded mp4 (107 frames, 768x1344), sha256 prefix | `d7ffac37f960` | `d7ffac37f960` |
| max abs pixel difference, frames 0 / 53 / 106 | - | 0 / 0 / 0 |


**Tile settings** (video latent shape unchanged, 768x1344 output):

| setting | unpatched `main` | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default 256 / 64 | mp4 `d7ffac37f960` | mp4 `d7ffac37f960` (identical) |
| 128 / 32 (valid) | mp4 `a7acbf523d2d` | mp4 `a7acbf523d2d` (identical to `main`, differs from default) |
| overlap == tile (256 / 256) | denoising finishes, then decoding hangs until the 900 s request timeout | `vae_tile_overlap_min must be less than vae_tile_size, got 256 >= 256` raised while loading the VAE |
| tile 250 | fails after denoising: `decoded frames 736x1280 smaller than target canvas 768x1344` | `vae_tile_size must be a multiple of the spatial compression ratio (16), got 250` raised while loading the VAE |

The 128 / 32 setting does take effect, and the same output comes from `main` and from this branch (max pixel difference 0 at frames 0, 53, 106). Native-resolution crop of frame 53, default tiling vs 128 / 32; the smaller tiles give visibly blockier shading, which is a property of that setting, not of this change:

![tiling crop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fusheng-ji/sglang/063f509fd4a5d9812fd7933cc2147db045ec244d/minimax-h3-tile.png)

When the problem is reported (measured, same job group; on the exact final head with all three fixes merged, overlap == tile fails at startup after 140 s):

| case | unpatched `main` | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| overlap == tile | healthy at 258.1 s, then the request times out at 900.5 s (total 1158.6 s) | startup error at 158 s |
| tile 250 | healthy at 258.1 s, request fails after 35.2 s (total 293.3 s) | startup error at 144 s |

![time to report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fusheng-ji/sglang/423113d8a26b0cda0e5b8586899655c2be2514db/minimax-h3-vae-time.png)

Times are seconds from server start. For `main`, healthy time and request time come from the harness; for this branch, the time is the timestamp of the startup error in the server log relative to the first log line (a few seconds after process start). The branch's process then takes about 1.5-2 more minutes to exit (existing shutdown behaviour), which is not counted. Weights were warm in the page cache, so the saving here is the rest of the load plus the failing request; for a remote repository it would also include the download. Run-to-run load time varies (main healthy in 249-312 s across these runs).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a performance change. The fix only touches the failure path / load-time validation; the regression run below produced bit-identical output, but latency was not measured.

Limitations: only the FL2VA partition, t2va, TP2 and one prompt/seed were run.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not applicable: no option or documented behaviour changes.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Accuracy only; this is a correctness fix and no speed measurement was made.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -21,6 +21,35 @@ def __reduce__(self):
         return (type(self), (self.component_name, self.detail))
 
 
+def validate_minimax_h3_vae_tiling(
+    tile_size: int, overlap: int, spatial_ratio: int, *, prefix: str = ""
+) -> None:
+    for name, value in (
+        (f"{prefix}tile_size", tile_size),
+        (f"{prefix}tile_overlap_min", overlap),
+    ):
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"MiniMax H3 VAE {name} must be a positive integer, got {value!r}"
+            )
+    if overlap >= tile_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"MiniMax H3 VAE {prefix}tile_overlap_min must be less than "
+            f"{prefix}tile_size, got {overlap} >= {tile_size}"
+        )
+    # Tiles are sliced and stitched in both pixel and latent coordinates.
+    # Alignment also prevents positive pixel overlap becoming zero in latents.
+    for name, value in (
+        (f"{prefix}tile_size", tile_size),
+        (f"{prefix}tile_overlap_min", overlap),
+    ):
+        if value % spatial_ratio:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"MiniMax H3 VAE {name} must be a multiple of the spatial "
+                f"compression ratio ({spatial_ratio}), got {value}"
+            )
+
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Reject tile settings that hang splitting or fail pixel/latent stitching."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.vaes.minimax_h3_video import (
+    MiniMaxH3VideoVAEConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.vaes.minimax_h3_video_vae.klvae import (
+    AutoencoderKL,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+class TestMiniMaxH3VAETiling(CustomTestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def make_vae(**kwargs):
+        # Exercise the real setup/split/assembly without allocating model weights.
+        vae = AutoencoderKL()
+        vae.vae_ratio = 16
+        vae.vae_ratio_t = 4
+        vae.transform = None
+        vae.transform_rev = None
+        vae.transform_rev_inplace = None
+        vae.use_3d_conv = True
+        vae.setup_forward(**kwargs)
+        return vae
+
+    def test_invalid_tiling_rejected_at_both_entry_points(self):
+        for field, values in (
+            ("tile_size", (0, -16, 64, 255, 256.5, True)),
+            ("tile_overlap_min", (0, -16, 256, 300, 1, 63, 64.5, True)),
+        ):
+            for value in values:
+                with self.subTest(field=field, value=value):
+                    config = MiniMaxH3VideoVAEConfig()
+                    setattr(config.arch_config, f"vae_{field}", value)
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                        ValueError, f"vae_{field}|tile_overlap_min"
+                    ):
+                        config.post_init()
+                    for prefix in ("", "decoder_"):
+                        with self.subTest(prefix=prefix):
+                            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                                ValueError, field + "|tile_overlap_min"
+                            ):
+                                self.make_vae(**{prefix + field: value})
+
+    def test_valid_tiles_reconstruct_pixel_and_latent_canvases(self):
+        for kwargs in (
+            {},
+            {"tile_size": 64, "tile_overlap_min": 16},
+            {"decoder_tile_size": 128, "decoder_tile_overlap_min": 32},
+        ):
+            vae = self.make_vae(**kwargs)
+            for is_decoder in (False, True):
+                for length in (128, 512, 528):
+                    with self.subTest(
+                        kwargs=kwargs, is_decoder=is_decoder, length=length
+                    ):
+                        starts, lengths, overlaps = vae.split_tiles(length, is_decoder)
+                        scale = 1 if is_decoder else vae.vae_ratio
+                        canvas = torch.arange(
+                            (length // scale) ** 2, dtype=torch.float32
+                        )
+                        canvas = canvas.reshape(
+                            1, 1, 1, length // scale, length // scale
+                        )
+                        rows = [
+                            [
+                                canvas[
+                                    ...,
+                                    y // scale : (y + h) // scale,
+                                    x // scale : (x + w) // scale,
+                                ].clone()
+                                for x, w in zip(starts, lengths)
+                            ]
+                            for y, h in zip(starts, lengths)
+                        ]
+                        overlap = [value // scale for value in overlaps]
+                        actual = vae._assemble_tiles(rows, overlap, overlap)
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, canvas)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
